scope: The ten books entire. Held for the ledger of the books (3.25), Gaius (3.28), Papias's two Johns (3.39), the Irenaeus sentence in Greek (3.18; 5.8), and Dionysius of Alexandria on Nepos and the Apocalypse (7.24–25).
verified_loci: HE 5.8.6 (Irenaeus, Adv. haer. 5.30.3, in Greek): seen not long ago, near the end of Domitian's reign — 'οὐδὲ γὰρ πρὸ πολλοῦ χρόνου ἑωράθη' (written in NFC as 'οὐδὲ γὰρ πρὸ πολλοῦ χρόνου ἑωράθη'; the seated TEI carries the oxia forms, so the locus is given in the text's own code points)

HE 3.25.4: the Apocalypse of John, 'if it seem right', which some reject and others count among the acknowledged — 'ἡ Ἰωάννου Ἀποκάλυψις, εἰ φανείη' (written in NFC as 'ἡ Ἰωάννου Ἀποκάλυψις, εἰ φανείη'; the seated TEI carries the oxia forms, so the locus is given in the text's own code points)
